changelog:
Summarize Pro 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Launched a powerful AI summarizer for text, documents, meetings, emails, reports, YouTube transcripts, and more.
- Supports multiple summary formats: TL;DR, bullet points, ELI5, key takeaways, executive summaries, chapter/meeting/email summaries, comparison, custom length, translations, and more.
- All data processing and storage are fully local (no external API calls or network requests; privacy-focused).
- User preferences, summary history, and templates saved locally for customization and quick access.
- Dropped the skill card; added metadata for system integration.
